description: We are a team from Diamond Bar, California
summary: We built a tool to train NASA's future astronauts for a mission to Mars, showing the ways that a mission can be done like what foods to pick and how to generate power. It addresses the challenge by letting players test their skills and try out ways of making a NASA mission successful.
details: We used scratch to make our project, and it works by having the player play the minigames to learn about a NASA trip to Mars. The game will hopefully inspire others to become astronauts. Our project has elements that team members drew including our logo, and we considered every aspect of the trip.
